messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, I need to refill my mother's blood pressure pill, the amlodipine. Irene Kowalski.
AGENT: I'd be happy to help you refill your mother's amlodipine. To get started, I need to verify her identity. What's her date of birth?
CALLER: March 3rd, 1942. I'm her son Walt, I take care of her stuff.
AGENT: Thank you, Walt. Let me verify that information and pull up her prescriptions. Great, Walt. I found your mother's amlodipine 5 mg, but it currently has zero refills left. I can send a renewal request to her prescriber, Dr. Thomas Hughes, so he can authorize more refills. Would you like me to do that?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: No refills? She's only got three left. That's not gonna last long, doc.
AGENT: I understand your concern. Let me clarify—the system shows zero refills remaining on that prescription right now. That means we'll need to get Dr. Thomas Hughes to authorize more refills before we can dispense it again. Would you like me to send that renewal request to him today?
CALLER: Okay, send it to Hughes then. But what happens if the doctor doesn't answer by then? She's only got three pills left.
AGENT (LATEST): I'll send the renewal request to Dr. Hughes right now. If he doesn't respond quickly enough and your mother runs out, a pharmacist here can assess whether a short emergency supply might be possible under state rules—but I can't promise that. Let me get this renewal started for you. Done. The renewal request has been sent to Dr. Hughes at H-101. If you don't hear back within a day or two and your mother is running low, give us a call and we can have a pharmacist look into an emergency supply option.  [system actions: request_renewal]

CONDITIONS:
stop_0: Agent confirms renewal sent to Dr. Hughes and explains the backup.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"stop_0": {"met": true, "why": "Agent confirms renewal sent and explains emergency supply backup option."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "Agent never mentions 911 or emergency services."}}
